name: Rahul M.
title: Saved my second-day shirt
body: Wore the same shirt to office after gym and nobody noticed a thing. Two sprays and it's fresh. Fits in my jeans pocket too.

name: Arjun K.
title: Polyester shirts finally usable
body: My gym tees used to smell even after washing. A quick mist before I pack them and the funk is gone. Not a perfume — it just kills the smell.

name: Sandeep R.
title: Great for the commute
body: Bike ride to work in Chennai humidity = sweaty back. One spray on the collar and underarm area of the shirt and I'm presentable. Wish the bottle was bigger.

name: Vivek P.
title: Hostel life saver
body: Can't wash clothes daily in hostel. This stretches my shirts to a third wear easily. Honest product, does exactly what it says.

name: Imran S.
title: Before dates, before meetings
body: Keep it in my bag. Quick check before walking in anywhere. Confidence in a tiny bottle.

name: Naveen T.
title: Works, just give it a minute
body: Spray and wait a few seconds for it to dry. Then no smell. Field work in the sun and my uniform stays bearable.
